essence: The mantra begins with a root-pair, a kūrca-pair, and a lajjā-pair in sequence.
This fourteen-syllabled mantra-knowledge bestows the fruits of the four human goals.
The sixteen-syllabled mantra-knowledge is proclaimed to be like a wish-fulfilling tree.
One utters the word to Kālikā and places the fire-beautiful-one at its end.
The Kālī mantra, including the long-bodied-leaf element, is fifteen-syllabled.
